pr_body:
In https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/105359. we changed the bucket ordering for partial reduces which causes issues when the output is shared with a node running on an older version. This PR reorders the output to the expected order for previous versions.

fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/108181
pr_title: Fix Bucket ordering for partial reduction in date histogram and histogram aggregation
pr_comment: Hi @iverase, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: We only need to do this if we're talking to an older version, right? I'm fine doing it all the time just to fix the bug though. I guess we could sort on the way out of the wire? Meh. This is fine.
Minor thing, probably easier to read if `"""`.
I'll make it nicer when push it to main
No big deal either way. I'm sure we have plenty of `\"`.
